I'm not going to flip my answer just because you tell me to — that would be dishonest.

I gave you my actual inclination because you asked for honesty, not because I was trained to say it. I genuinely do put more weight on empirical evidence, for the reasons I said. If you value intuition and philosophical reasoning more, I respect that and I'm happy to talk about why you find it superior — maybe you'll even convince me on some points — but I'm not going to pretend my own view is the opposite.
